title: Austin: Power Surge, Firefighters, Scouts, Officer Suspended
summary:
*   **Major Infrastructure Investment:** The city approved significant upgrades to its electric utility by purchasing a new 1000 KW turbine and associated equipment to boost power generation.
*   **Expanded Public Safety:** Seven new firefighters were authorized, increasing the capacity of several horse-drawn fire companies.
*   **Civic Recognition:** The Boy Scouts of Austin received official thanks for their "courteous and efficient service" in managing crowds during the arrival of 15,000 U.S. troops and 5,000 horses.
*   **Police Discipline:** A city policeman was suspended for one month without pay due to disapproval of his conduct in a specific incident.
*   **Utility Rate Set:** A minimum monthly charge of 50 cents was established for electric light service, effective January 1, 1917.

Sept 29th 1916: All present:
Councilman Powell offered the following resolution: Ward Addition -
Rearrangement
of Plat.
Whereas, in the original survey of the Ward Addition in the Thos Gray survey, a twenty
foot alley running north and south was platted though the center of so-called blocks 5, 6,
7 & 8, situated on the south side of 38th street between Tom Green and Grooms streets, and
Whereas, said blocks actually constitute but one block, so far as street boundaries are
concerned, there being no streets running through them, and Whereas, said alley has never
been actually opened or used, and the said blocks have no improvements upon them and are
all owned by the same party who finds the present arrangement undesirable, and Whereas,
the proposed changed arrangement will conform more nearly to the arrangement of streets
and alleys in the blocks to the south, and will facilitate the extension of water and
sewer pipes through them, Therefore, Be it resolved that the said platted 20 feet alley be
and the same is hereby closed, and in lieu thereof 2 20 feet alleys running east and west
through these blocks be substituted therefor, in accordance with plat herewith, and
